strings.name: Michael Phelps
strings.summary: Phelps combined butterfly, medley and other individual events with relay contributions to win 28 Olympic medals, including 23 golds. His eight golds at Beijing became a defining achievement. After retirement, his foundation promoted water safety while he spoke publicly about athletes’ mental health.
strings.coverageNote: Sources checked through 13 November 2026. Selected milestones; competitions, affiliations and records refer to their cited dates, not an exhaustive match log.
strings.influence.rationale: His Olympic medal achievements set a global sporting benchmark, alongside continuing advocacy for athletes’ mental health.

strings.highlights.highlight-1.title: Olympic records
strings.highlights.highlight-1.text: Won 28 Olympic medals, including 23 golds, across individual and relay events.
strings.highlights.highlight-2.title: Swimming and wellbeing
strings.highlights.highlight-2.text: Founded a water-safety charity and used personal experience to advance mental-health discussion.
strings.timeline.event-1.title: Foundation campaign launched
strings.timeline.event-1.text: Thrive Together began supporting water safety and mental-wellness education; the campaign remained ongoing.
strings.timeline.event-2.title: Retirement after Rio
strings.timeline.event-2.text: Won five golds and a silver in Rio, ending competitive swimming with 28 Olympic medals.
strings.timeline.event-3.title: Mental-health disclosure
strings.timeline.event-3.text: Shared personal experiences, broadening discussion of athletes’ emotional wellbeing.
strings.timeline.event-4.title: Return to competition
strings.timeline.event-4.text: Ended his post-London retirement and resumed racing.
strings.timeline.event-5.title: Six medals in London
strings.timeline.event-5.text: Won four golds and two silvers, extending his Olympic medal total.
strings.timeline.event-6.title: Beijing and foundation
strings.timeline.event-6.text: Won eight golds at one Olympics and founded his charity that year.
strings.timeline.event-7.title: First Olympic medals
strings.timeline.event-7.text: Won six golds and two bronzes in Athens across individual and relay events.
strings.timeline.event-8.title: Olympic debut
strings.timeline.event-8.text: Competed in Sydney aged 15 without winning a medal.
strings.timeline.event-9.title: Born in Baltimore
strings.timeline.event-9.text: Grew up in Maryland and entered structured swimming training as a child.
